summary: Attempted to verify the FaultDialogs.js native <select> fix for the Serial Number dropdown in the Log-a-Fault modal as owner@isodemo.com. The opened dialog has NO data-testid='issue-dialog', NO Serial Number dropdown at all, and still uses a Radix Select trigger ('Choose machine type...') for Machine Type. Although no Serial Number dropdown is present, the same root cause may still recur.
critical_code_review_comments: FaultDialogs.js source-review: the fix is correct in principle — both selects are native <select>, both have onKeyDown stopPropagation, Dialog blocks outside/escape/focus interactions. The 'serial unknown' fallback <select> also has the same guard (good).

However, the suppressCloseRef + uploadActiveRef double-guard is fragile — once uploadActiveRef becomes true it disables back-gesture-close for the rest of the session. This is intentional but worth flagging — users on mobile won't be able to swipe-back to close after attaching media; they MUST tap X/Cancel/submit. Consider re-arming the back-gesture after a short cool-down.
Console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on the Lite dialog — minor a11y issue.

The Log-a-Fault entry button has both 'Log a Fault' (top of Dashboard) and 'Log New Fault' (inside the Reactive Faults panel) — they open the same Lite dialog. Worth de-duplicating once the Pro/Lite routing is sorted.
